block.title: Zone D enemies: flailing ember wisps and an erupting magma cone turret in a lava shaft
block.positive: SNES-era 16-bit pixel art inspired concept rendering, bold dark outlines, saturated limited palette, widescreen 16:9 side-scrolling arcade composition, subtle CRT scanline glow. A volcanic shaft in a invaded star system's molten depths: the background is an erupting cave of cooling black basalt crossed with glowing lava cracks, a lava lake at the shaft floor burning through a gradient from dark ember red to bright tangerine, falling droplets of lava trailing gold sparks, heat ripple warping the upper rock. Mid-field, two hostile mechanical-organic swarm creatures converge on a tiny sleek steel-blue dart fighter with a bold blue hull stripe, cyan canopy and bright orange engine glow in the lower left: EMBER WISPS — fist-sized feral flames with a single molten gold core each, wisp bodies of layered orange and red flame tongues, sparking tails smearing behind their erratic darting paths, no faces, just hungry light; and a MAGMA CONE — a squat volcanic turret of stacked blackened rock plates veined with lava, its crater mouth cracked wide mid-eruption belching a fan of pink and red molten shot with bright cores and dark rims. Deep-navy-black shadow pockets (never pure black) against the furnace light, orange-white explosion bloom in a side tunnel.
block.negative: photorealistic, 3d render, text, watermark, blurry, pure black background, human figures, cartoon mascot, soft pastel palette, volumetric fog, lens flare
block.notes: Heat-light from below is the mood anchor — the shot reads as an ambush inside the furnace. Lava ramp color reference: #8a2c0a→#e87a1c; brick wall accents #b0704a; bullets #ff3a3a/#ff5aa0. Wisps should stay small: at most a tenth of the ship's size each, so scale contrast sells the swarm menace.
